source: Instagram Platform API (Instagram Graph API / Instagram API with Instagram Login) v23.0 - IG User node, IG User Insights, IG Media node, IG Media Insights
note: no native BigQuery export - schema designed by us

tables.name: ig_Account
tables.grain: one row per Instagram professional account per pull day (_DATA_DATE); current state = _DATA_DATE = _LATEST_DATE

tables.name: ig_DailyStats
tables.grain: one row per Instagram account per day (segments_date = _DATA_DATE)

tables.name: ig_Media
tables.grain: one row per IG media per pull day (post_id x _DATA_DATE); latest state = _DATA_DATE = _LATEST_DATE

tables.name: ig_Demographics
tables.grain: one row per account x pull day x demographic metric x segment_type x segment_value
